title: 💰 What Fees Do I Need to Pay?
content:
🌟 Simple overview

When buying products from China through our website, you may need to pay:

  1. Product price
  2. Domestic shipping fee within China
  3. Service fee
  4. International shipping fee
  5. Optional warehouse service fees
  6. Customs duties or import taxes
  7. Payment processing fee, if applicable
  8. Storage fee, if applicable

Not every order will include all of these fees. The final cost depends on your product, destination country, shipping method, and selected services.


1. 🛍️ Product price

The product price is the price charged by the Chinese seller.

This is usually the price shown on platforms such as 1688, Taobao, Weidian, or other Chinese marketplaces.

Please note:

  • Different colors, sizes, or models may have different prices
  • Product prices may change at any time
  • Discount prices may only be available for a limited time
  • Some sellers may update the price after you submit the order
  • Some products may become out of stock before purchase

If the seller changes the price or the selected option is unavailable, we may contact you for confirmation before continuing the purchase.


2. 🚚 Domestic shipping fee within China

Domestic shipping fee refers to the shipping cost from the Chinese seller to our China warehouse.

This fee is charged by the seller or the domestic courier in China.

Common situations include:

  • The seller offers free domestic shipping
  • The seller charges a fixed domestic shipping fee
  • The fee depends on product weight or quantity
  • The fee may be higher for remote areas in China
  • Multiple items from the same seller may share one domestic shipping fee

Domestic shipping is different from international shipping. It only covers the delivery from the Chinese seller to our China warehouse.


3. 🧾 Service fee

The service fee is charged for the shopping agent service we provide.

It may cover services such as:

  • Helping you purchase products from Chinese sellers
  • Processing your shopping order
  • Communicating with sellers when needed
  • Receiving items at our China warehouse
  • Updating order and warehouse status
  • Basic warehouse handling
  • System and customer support services

The service fee may be calculated in different ways, depending on our website rules.

For example:

  • A percentage of the product price
  • A fixed fee per order
  • A fee based on item quantity
  • A different fee rate based on membership level or service plan

Please check the order page for the exact service fee before payment.


4. ✈️ International shipping fee

International shipping fee is the cost of shipping your parcel from our China warehouse to your destination country or region.

This fee is usually calculated after your items arrive at our warehouse.

The international shipping fee may depend on:

  • Destination country or region
  • Shipping method
  • Actual weight
  • Package size
  • Chargeable weight
  • Product type
  • Whether the item is restricted or sensitive
  • Whether extra packaging is required
  • Customs or tax handling rules, if applicable

Please note that the international shipping fee is usually not included in the first payment for the product order.

You need to pay it separately when submitting your parcel for international shipping.


5. 📦 Optional warehouse service fees

When your items arrive at our warehouse, you may request extra services.

Some services may be free, while others may require an additional fee.

Common optional services include:

  • Extra photos
  • Repacking
  • Removing original packaging
  • Keeping shoe boxes
  • Reinforcement
  • Waterproof packaging
  • Bubble wrap protection
  • Fragile item protection
  • Package splitting
  • Special label or note
  • Return or exchange assistance

Optional services are only charged when you select or request them.

Please note that some services may increase or decrease the final package weight and size.

For example, reinforcement may make the parcel safer, but it may also increase the weight or volume. Removing unnecessary packaging may help reduce the package size in some cases.


6. 🌍 Customs duties and import taxes

When your parcel arrives in your destination country, local customs may charge duties, import taxes, VAT, or other fees.

These fees are usually decided by your country’s customs authority.

They may depend on:

  • Destination country
  • Product category
  • Declared value
  • Quantity
  • Shipping method
  • Local import rules
  • Whether the parcel is considered personal use or commercial use

Please note:

  • International shipping fee does not always include customs duties or taxes
  • Some shipping methods may include tax handling
  • Some shipping methods require the receiver to pay taxes after arrival
  • Customs duties and import taxes are usually charged by the destination country, not by our website

Before shipping, please check whether your selected shipping method includes tax handling.


7. 💳 Payment processing fee

Some payment methods may include a payment processing fee.

This fee may be charged by third-party payment providers, banks, card networks, or online payment platforms.

Examples may include:

  • Credit card processing fee
  • PayPal fee
  • Stripe fee
  • Currency conversion fee
  • Bank transfer fee
  • Other payment channel fees

If a payment processing fee applies, it will usually be shown on the payment page before you complete payment.


8. 🏠 Storage fee

After your items arrive at our China warehouse, they may be stored for free for a certain period.

If your items stay in the warehouse longer than the free storage period, a storage fee may be charged.

To avoid storage fees, please submit your items for international shipping before the free storage period ends.

Storage fees may depend on:

  • Number of items
  • Storage time
  • Product size
  • Warehouse rules
  • Whether the item is oversized or special

Please check the warehouse policy for the exact free storage period and storage fee rules.


9. ⚠️ Special handling fees

Some products may require special handling because of their size, weight, material, or shipping restrictions.

Special handling fees may apply to:

  • Oversized items
  • Heavy items
  • Fragile items
  • Liquid or powder products
  • Battery products
  • Magnetic items
  • Sensitive items
  • Items requiring special packaging
  • Items that need manual processing
  • Unclaimed or unclear packages

If special handling is required, the system or customer service may notify you before processing.


10. 🔄 Refund-related costs

If you cancel an order, return an item, or request a refund, some costs may not be fully refundable.

This may include:

  • Domestic shipping fee already paid to the seller
  • Return shipping fee within China
  • Payment processing fee
  • Service fee, depending on the order status
  • Packaging or warehouse service fee already used
  • Exchange rate difference
  • Fees charged by third-party payment providers

The refundable amount depends on the order status, seller policy, and our website rules.

Please contact customer service as soon as possible if you need to cancel or return an item.


Example: A typical cost structure

Here is a simple example.

You buy one pair of shoes from China.

First payment: Shopping order

This may include:

  • Product price
  • Domestic shipping fee in China
  • Service fee

After this payment, we purchase the shoes from the Chinese seller.

Warehouse stage

The shoes arrive at our China warehouse.

You may choose:

  • Keep the shoe box
  • Remove the shoe box
  • Add reinforcement
  • Combine with other items

Some options may affect the final package size and shipping fee.

Second payment: International shipping

This may include:

  • International shipping fee
  • Optional warehouse service fee, if selected
  • Other shipping-related fees, if applicable

After this payment, we pack and ship your parcel.

After arrival

Depending on your country and shipping method, customs duties or import taxes may be charged by local customs or the delivery company.


How to reduce your total cost

Here are some tips that may help reduce your cost:

  • Check the estimated shipping fee before buying large or heavy items
  • Combine multiple items into one parcel when suitable
  • Remove unnecessary packaging if you do not need it
  • Choose an economical shipping method if delivery time is not urgent
  • Avoid buying restricted or sensitive products unless necessary
  • Confirm product size, color, and quantity before submitting the order
  • Ship your items before the free storage period ends
  • Contact customer service before buying oversized or special items

Please note that the cheapest option is not always the best option. For fragile, valuable, or urgent items, a safer or faster shipping method may be more suitable.


Important notes

  • The product price is not the total final cost.
  • Domestic shipping and international shipping are different fees.
  • International shipping is usually calculated after the item arrives at our warehouse.
  • Customs duties and import taxes may not be included in the shipping fee.
  • Optional warehouse services may generate extra fees.
  • Storage fees may apply if items stay in the warehouse too long.
  • The final cost depends on the actual order, package, shipping method, and destination country.


Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: Is the product price the final amount I need to pay?

No. The product price only covers the item itself. You may also need to pay domestic shipping, service fee, international shipping, and possibly customs duties or taxes.

Q2: Is domestic shipping the same as international shipping?

No. Domestic shipping means shipping from the Chinese seller to our China warehouse. International shipping means shipping from our China warehouse to your country.

Q3: Why is my international shipping fee higher than expected?

Possible reasons include actual weight, package size, volume weight, selected shipping method, destination country, or product type. Large but lightweight items may still cost more because they take up more space.

Q4: Do I have to pay customs duties?

It depends on your destination country and the shipping method. Some parcels may not be taxed, while others may require import duties, VAT, or other local fees.

Q5: Are optional warehouse services required?

No. Optional services are only needed if you request them. For example, you may choose reinforcement for fragile items or extra photos if you want to check more details.

Q6: Can I know the total cost before buying?

You can estimate the cost before buying, but the final international shipping fee can only be confirmed after the item arrives at our warehouse and the package is measured.

Q7: What should I do if I do not understand a fee?

Please contact customer service before payment. We can help you check the order, explain the fee, and confirm the next step.


Need help?

If you are unsure about the fees before placing an order, please contact our customer service team.

To help us assist you faster, please provide:

  • Product link or screenshot
  • Quantity
  • Destination country
  • Preferred shipping method, if any
  • Your order number, if available
  • The fee you want to confirm

We will help you understand the estimated cost and avoid unnecessary confusion before payment.
